# runtime-attempt-report-writer (reference summary)

## Purpose
Produce an evidence-bound runtime attempt report with truth labels and next steps; does not certify upstream stack success.

Record a chronological, secret-free runtime attempt log—including version stamps, downgrade-only truth labels, and routed next steps—for Path 1, Path 2, or CLI appendix runs. A report produced by this skill can serve as an in-repo provenance record under `docs/evals/`, without certifying artifact quality or diagnosing runtime defects.

## Metadata & truth boundary
- **Canonical skill:** `skills/runtime-attempt-report-writer/SKILL.md`
- **Contract:** `skills/runtime-attempt-report-writer/contract.json` (`v1.0.0`)
- **Category / role:** `runtime-and-execution` / `execution-attempt-provenance-logger`
- **Capability tier:** `L0`
- **Truth-state policy:** Runtime status defaults to `Not Run`; Artifact status defaults to `Not Produced`; mutation rule is `downgrade_only` (never upgrade without verified evidence).

## When to use
- after any Blender connect attempt (success or failure)
- preparing notes for `docs/evals/` style provenance
- teaching non-technical stakeholders what actually occurred

## Trigger cues
- "write up what we tried"
- "runtime attempt log"
- "postmortem blender connect"
- "evidence report template"

## When not to use
- Classifying rendered or exported visual artifacts (render-export-evidence) → delegate to `render-export-evidence` (`references/skills/render-export-evidence.md`; render-export-evidence)
- Diagnosing systematic runtime or scene defects (blender-troubleshooting) → delegate to `blender-troubleshooting` (`references/skills/blender-troubleshooting.md`; blender-troubleshooting)
- Running pre-attempt environment checks (official-runtime-readiness-checker) → delegate to `official-runtime-readiness-checker` (`references/skills/official-runtime-readiness-checker.md`; official-runtime-readiness-checker)
- Selecting which runtime path to use before an attempt (runtime-path-picker) → delegate to `runtime-path-picker` (`references/skills/runtime-path-picker.md`; runtime-path-picker)
- Performing final release or delivery gating (pre-handoff-verification) → delegate to `pre-handoff-verification` (`references/skills/pre-handoff-verification.md`; pre-handoff-verification)

## Inputs & output/evidence contract
### Required inputs
- `attempted_runtime_path_and_host` (`object`): Path 1, Path 2, or CLI appendix route and MCP host configuration used during the attempt
- `chronological_execution_log` (`array`): Timestamped sequence of read-only or mutation tool calls, responses, and observed outcomes
- `version_stamps` (`object`): Exact Blender version, add-on version, and MCP client version strings

### Optional inputs
- `pre_mutation_backup_record` (`object`): Optional .blend checkpoint backup metadata if an L1+ mutation was attempted

### Primary outputs
- `structured_runtime_attempt_report_md`
- `locked_runtime_and_artifact_truth_labels`
- `eval_evidence_archival_path`

## Quick-start procedure
1. gather timestamps, commands/config surfaces touched (no secrets)
2. choose blocks from `skills/runtime-attempt-report-writer/references/truth-label-blocks.md`
3. fill `skills/runtime-attempt-report-writer/references/attempt-record-template.md`
4. route improvements via `skills/runtime-attempt-report-writer/references/triage-next-steps.md`

## Handoff notes
- **[upstream_reference]** Pre-attempt readiness check → `official-runtime-readiness-checker` (`references/skills/official-runtime-readiness-checker.md`) — `when.all: [runtime.path not_equals "unselected"; runtime.verifiedReady equals false]`
- **[upstream_reference]** Runtime path selection context → `runtime-path-picker` (`references/skills/runtime-path-picker.md`) — `when.all: [runtime.path equals "unselected"]`
- **[fallback]** Bridge / port / host conflicts → `runtime-bridge-conflict-resolver` (`references/skills/runtime-bridge-conflict-resolver.md`) — `when.all: [runtime.conflictDetected equals true]`
- **[fallback]** Runtime or scene defect diagnosis → `blender-troubleshooting` (`references/skills/blender-troubleshooting.md`) — `when.all: [runtime.errorDetected equals true]`
- **[progression]** Artifact evidence classification → `render-export-evidence` (`references/skills/render-export-evidence.md`) — `when.all: [stage.current equals "post_execution_audit"]`
- **[fallback]** Final handoff gate & failure exit → `pre-handoff-verification` (`references/skills/pre-handoff-verification.md`) — `when.any: [gate.status equals "failed"; runtime.mode equals "blocked"]`

## Safety boundaries & non-goals
- **Runtime boundary:** Documentation skill only—never executes Blender or generates Python. Reports must strictly preserve upstream runtime distinctions: - **Path 1**: Official Blender Lab MCP in Blender 5.1+, hosted from (a) Anthropic Connector or (b) manual MCP client. The Connector is NOT standalone. - **Path 2**: Community `mcp-for-blender` (third-party, Blender 3.0+); document only with explicit caveats and never treat as release evidence. - **CLI fallback**: Appendix only (`blender --background --python`); remains upstream-documented with no in-repo evidence file unless a report written by this skill becomes one under `docs/evals/`.
- Executing Blender, running MCP commands, or writing Python scripts.
- Certifying visual artifact quality or export integrity (owned by `render-export-evidence`).
- Diagnosing runtime crashes, bridge conflicts, or scene errors (owned by `blender-troubleshooting` and `runtime-bridge-conflict-resolver`).
- Approving final delivery packages without passing through `pre-handoff-verification`.
